title: ERNIE Bot Introduction
summary: Baidu introduced ERNIE Bot on March 16, 2023 as a new-generation large language model and generative AI product, with invited-user access beginning that day and enterprise API access available by application through Baidu AI Cloud.
significance: A documented public introduction milestone for Baidu's ERNIE Bot conversational generative-AI system.

geography.note: Baidu's March 16, 2023 release identifies Beijing as the location of the ERNIE Bot press conference where Robin Li presented the system.

verification.note: Baidu's first-party March 16 release directly states that the company introduced ERNIE Bot that day, describes it as a new-generation LLM and generative-AI product, and states that invited-user access began March 16. Baidu's Q1 2023 investor-results release independently confirms that ERNIE Bot had been introduced in China during the quarter. Beijing is recorded only as the announcement location, not as a development or training location. No ancestry, influence, causality or relationships are inferred.

sources.title: Baidu Unveils ERNIE Bot, the Latest Generative AI Mastering Chinese Language and Multi-Modal Generation

candidateMeta.admissionReason: First-party evidence directly supports the March 16, 2023 introduction and initial invited-user availability milestone, with separate Baidu corporate corroboration.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Consider chronology-safe canonical admission as an introduction/access milestone; preserve Beijing strictly as announcement-location unless separate evidence supports other geography semantics.
